lines.en: There’s this tree I walk past some nights when I don’t know what to do with myself.
I guess you can probably surmise I’ve visited it a lot with that in mind.
For the first few years, it was merely coincidental.
Just a thing I’d pass by on my way from one place to the next.
But it’s changing now — and so am I.
It’s started to blossom.
This is spring, after all. It was only a matter of time until that scent and those colors found their way back to me.
Just like she did.
I keep thinking I’ll see her beneath it — standing there with her palm outstretched, hoping the wind sodomizes the branches and delivers a petal or two to her fingers.
There’s nothing ever there, though. Because she only visits me when I don’t want her to.
Sometimes I’m just lonely, though.
Sometimes, I just miss her.
That’s okay, right?
My phone goes off in my pocket.
It’s like a portable, hand-held god.
: Hello?
: Hey, Akira. Any chance you could meet up tonight? There’s something I want to talk to you about.
: Am I allowed to know what it is beforehand? Or is this one of those things where I get blindsided by drama and thrown into a lake of sorrow where I must either sink or swim?
: Lake of Sorrow is an album by Sins of Thy Beloved.
: Cool. That doesn’t answer my question, though.
: It’s about Rin. Just come over and I’ll tell you more, okay?
: Rin? Did something happen to her? Is everything-
: Just come over...and I will tell you more. Okay?
: Oh...yeah. I’ll head over now.
: Bring cheese, if you can. It’s important.
: You don’t...still have that rat. Do-
: Bye, Akira! See you soon!
Rika hangs up the phone and I have no intention to deliver cheese to her house.
Not because I’m evil, though. My evilness has no relation to the amount of cheese I am capable of transporting.
I’m just a little worried, that’s all.
But I guess there’s a baseline of permanent worry when it comes to Rin since I’ve seen firsthand what she’s done to herself in the past.
So...I hope this has nothing to do with that.
And I hope that, whatever it is, both she and Rika will be okay.
I ring the bell once I get to Rika’s place. The lights above the doors that belong to Yuki and Imani are both out, so I guess she’s the only one around tonight.
: Come in! It’s open!
: Hey! Thanks for coming to me. People don’t really like it when I bring Frankenstein out in public.
: So you really kept it, huh?
: Of course! Just look at him. Who could ever turn away an adorable face like this?
: Besides, if that thing Imani said about rats only living for three years is true, I want to make sure the last...however many years he has left are as good as they can be.
: Well, I’m glad you and your son are happy together. And I’m also glad to see you actually have some furniture now.
: It’s a work in progress. But all I really need is a futon and a table to eat stuff at.
: I see you kept the chalk outlines too.
: They make good decorations. And I figured that if I ever have a heart attack or die of old age or something, I could just lie down on top of them and make life easier for whoever finds my body.
: I think they only do the outlining thing for homicide investigations.
: I guess I just have to hope my potential murderer is as kind as me then, huh?
: Guess so, Rika.
: So...that thing you wanted to talk about.
: Mhm?
: Mind filling me in now? Or were you only luring me over with your daughter’s name because you thought it would get me here quicker?
: Why would I think that, Akira?
: Because I’ve known her longer and care about her more than you.
: Wow. Harsh.
: I’m sure you’ll work your way up the rankings. But, as it stands, I’ve just been through way more with her.
: It’s fine, I get it. I obviously also care about her more than you too.

: Rin is, to put it plainly...the greatest thing that’s ever happened to me. More than Rie. More than Frankenstein. Even more than that time I made out with Robert Plant when he played in Fukuoka in ‘96.
: Well, I am very glad you like your daughter more than some rockstar’s tongue.
: And I’m glad to hear you do too. Though, your opinion is obviously skewed since you’ve never made out with a rockstar.
: I’ve boned an idol, though. That has to count for something.
: It does. That Niki girl’s super cute. But the point is, we both care about Rin and we both want what’s best for her. Right?
: Right.
: Good. Then let’s make a deal to be as blunt as possible from this point on so there are no misunderstandings at all about what we’re dealing with. Okay?
: Uhh...okay. I still don’t really get what’s happening, though.
: Do you remember the night when I took your phone?
: Of course I remember. I could hardly walk the next day after learning what it meant to do it “Ghana style.”
: Which isn’t even mentioning how hard it was for me to calm Ami down when I got home. I had to explain like ten times that I couldn’t answer her calls because of you.
: And I’m sorry for that, okay? I went into rabid mom mode and wasn’t thinking clearly.
: You told me you were using it as a flashlight to find a key you dropped in the sewer outside.

: Which was not a lie, actually. I did do that when I got back. But only for a couple minutes before I realized I could just use my own phone for that and yours was dying from Ami calling it so many times.
: The full truth, though...
: Is that...
: Rin texted you.
: Many times, actually. Which is the only reason I picked your phone up in the first place since it wouldn’t stop going off and was really annoying me.
: Did she? I don’t remember seeing anything.
: That’s because I deleted everything.
: You...went through my messages?
: Not all of them. I do respect your privacy despite the whole...thievery thing. It was only the stuff Rin sent that night that I got rid of. That’s all I saw.
: Rika, I get why you’d be worried about that, and...you know, I guess it is technically inappropriate for me to have her number. But it’s not like I’m using it for nefarious purposes or anything.
: You already know I hang out at the dorms sometimes. And-
: Akira, she...
: The stuff she sent to you that night was so graphic that I don’t even want to repeat it.
: What?
: Be honest with me. As a parent, not a friend. Or...maybe as a friend if you find it easier to talk that way? Has Rin ever-
: Graphic how, Rika? What does that mean?
: Hah. Fine. I told you we should be blunt, so I’m going to be blunt. We can be mature about this.
: She sent you basically an entire essay about wanting to have sex with you, complete with a five minute video of her...you know.
: Rin did? You’re sure it was her?
: Yeah. I think I know my daughter when I see her.
: Why?
: You’ve really...never gotten anything like that from her before?
: No...never.
Not directly, at least.
: I see...
: I guess she wasn’t lying about literally everything then.
: So you just...believe me then? That’s it?
: You don’t get expressive often. So when you do, it’s easy to tell exactly how you’re feeling. And I know confusion when I see it. I own a mirror.
: What...happened after that?
: Well, after she invited you over to pound her with the intensity of a western silverback, which is a type of gorilla, I sent her a text from your phone saying I was on the way.
: Once I got there, she opened the door and...it was like a flip switched inside of me.

: I don’t get serious often. It hurts my head. But this girl, a girl I have nurtured and supported and admired for so many years...turned me into, like...a discipline robot with the snap of her fingers.
: I took her phone...tried to warn her about what she was doing and how much trouble she could get you in by sending that stuff, but I don’t even know if I got through in the end.

: It’s scary, you know? Like, I’m not going to think less of her for having a crush on her teacher. We’ve all done that. But never in a million years did I think she’d go out of her way to, like...try and rope you into it.
: Like, where the hell did she get that from?
: I have no idea...
: Anyway, please don’t bring this up to her. I’ve embarrassed her enough and she’d straight up kill me if she found out I told you about this. I just need to know for sure that nothing’s going on.
: Yeah...of course...
: I’ve never even touched her.
A lie, of course. But one worth telling as the single kiss I shared with her amounted to little more than false hope and a few bundles of tissues.
Rika can’t know I’ll never forget it, though. Not when she’s already suspicious.
That was so long ago, now.
I doubt it even crosses her mind.
: Did you even know she felt this way about you?
: I thought she felt the exact opposite way about me. She’s been obsessed with girls the entire time I’ve known her.
: Well, I guess it’s your turn then. Because I doubt this is going to just go away overnight. Rin has so much love to give, that’s why it always, like...overflows whenever she finds somebody.
: At the very least, she knows it’s wrong. You know it’s wrong. That’s not going to stop the way she feels, though. She needs...I don’t know. She needs something.

: Like, I don’t want to tell you go break the girl’s heart or anything because I don’t want her, like...romantically traumatized or stunted by a grown man telling her to back off. She doesn’t even know you know yet.
: So my only idea is, like...wait for it to blow over? But that sounds too passive and her other mom agrees. Just neither of us knows what the best course of action is right now, so...
: At least you’re in the know now. So if she ever comes at you again, just...let her down gently, okay? That’s my baby girl. She’s just...being a little dumb right now.
: She gets it from me, I guess.
: You’re a great mom, Rika. Don’t let yourself think otherwise.
: You should see Rie. She’s like a...mom magician. A momgician. A...mom...
: Aaah! Now I want to cry again!
: You still really miss her, don’t you?
: Yeah, but...
: More than that, I think I just miss being loved all together.
: Wakana has Osako. Imani has you. Who does that leave me with? A rat? Who’s going to love me this late in life, Akira? Nobody.
: Question — have you tried witchcraft?
: Of course I’ve tried witchcraft. They’d have revoked my lesbian license by now if I hadn’t. Still nothing, though.
: You’ll find someone, I’m sure.
: How do you know that, though?
: Because you’re extremely fucking hot, Rika. Like, disturbingly so.
: Aww, thank you! Now I’m in a good mood again.
: Mmm but now I’m sad again because I’m remembering my daughter wants to fuck old people.
: Could be worse. My daughter specifically only wants to have sex with me.
: Rin wanted to marry Rie when she was younger. Maybe it’s just a daughter thing?
: Did you ever want to have sex with either of your parents?
: No. But my uncle grabbed my boob once. He said it was an accident, but I never believed him. He’s dead now though, so my boobs are finally safe.
: I’m happy for you, Rika. I’m happy for your boobs too.
: Awww! Are you actually smiling?!
: Trying to. I’m still learning.
: Hahah...
: We never really stop learning, do we?
: Even now, at 42 years old, I’m learning things about my daughter. About how to deal with new...weird problems I never expected. And I’ve already dealt with so much for her, you know?
: Depression’s no joke, dude. It took us so long to find a therapist that she actually clicked with. It was like one of those...what do you call it, again? Oh! Noodle in a haystack.
: Needle.
: Needle? No. A noodle would be harder to find. It won’t poke you.
: You’re...not wrong?
: Oh no! I killed the smile. Bring it back!
: I can only manage it for a few seconds at a time. Don’t take it personally.
: Oh, I won’t. Not taking things personally is my specialty when I am the legal guardian of a hormonal gremlin who keeps adding a year to my age. The joys of parenting, am I right?
: I’m still new to that too. I wouldn’t really know.
: Yeah...
: You’re doing a great job though, Akira.
: How would you even know? You’ve never seen me in action.
: Ami called you like five hundred times the night I had your phone. I’m lucky if Rin calls me once per week.
: Ami’s different.
: Ami loves you.
: For good reason, too. Deep beneath all that anguish and torment in that lake of sorrow you call your heart, there’s a caring, gentle little boy who just wants the people he loves to be happy.
: Lake of Sorrow is an album by Sins of Thy Beloved.
: You remember.
: I remember all sorts of things. But I forget even more.
: Those sound like lyrics. Are you trying to start a band right now?
: I’m not sure either one of us has the time between dealing with our respective daughters and how horny they are for me.
: I’m horny for you too, Akira.
: I’m sorry, what?
: What?
: Did you just-
: Yeah.
: And was that-
: Yeah.
: Uhhhhh...
: I’ve won over like twenty girls with that move. Blatant admission and direct eye contact.
: Yeah, you haven’t blinked once.
: That’s how you know I’m serious.
: Are you serious?
: If I said yes, what would you do?
: Fuck you.
: Bzzzt! You’re torn between my best friend and a famous pop star. Both of which are much smarter and cuter than me. Do not be tricked by my vast experience and feminine wiles.
: Also, do you have any idea how much it would fuck Rin up if she found out her mom had sex with the boy she likes?
: She actually told me to have sex with you once.
: What? Why?
: To fix you, I think?
: Good reason. It would definitely help.
: You’re doing the eye thing again.
: Oh, you don’t need to tell me. I’m well aware of what I’m doing.
: I-Imani! It’s not what it looks like! We were just-
